quarterly_data.quarter: ASUS press release: ASUS Advances AI Factories with Integrated Infrastructure (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At ASUS AI Tech 2026 (Seoul, September 3) ASUS presented its NVIDIA-based AI factory portfolio: the ASUS AI POD XA VR721-E3, a rack-scale platform built on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 (stated as 10X the performance per watt versus the prior generation); the XA NR1I-E12LR and XA NR1I-E12L based on NVIDIA HGX Rubin NVL8; the XA P2N-E2, a 2U NVIDIA MGX platform with two NVIDIA Vera CPUs and up to two dual-slot GPUs; the ESC8000-E12P with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 / RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs; and the UF920-E3-RS24 storage server on the NVIDIA STX modular foundation. ASUS pairs its system engineering with the NVIDIA DSX Sim Blueprint to simulate AI factories before installation. The release says strong business growth reflects rising demand for integrated AI infrastructure. No availability dates, customers or volumes are stated.
